selection.strategy: simple random sample of fixed PASS_V2; first 100 nested in first 300; selection independent of file hydration and label presence

original_unchanged_label_results.candidate_rule: First usable CORE label per patient/VISIT_ID/label in physician record families; explicit nearby past markers and named non-target procedure titles excluded from candidate counts, retained in label statistics. Backtrack to earliest judgment-bearing record within same visit and 24/48/168h; deduplicate identical selected source record keys. This is a conservative candidate retrieval count, not a validated decision count. It can miss repeated reassessments with unchanged labels and within-visit events. Generic predecessor targets and historical carry-forward still require review.
original_unchanged_label_results.imaging_rule: Nearest preceding recorded CT/MR exam across supplied history, grouped by exam number/time/modality. Exam time is not report availability or proof of relevance; version conflicts are not resolved by pairing.

supplement_pattern.operation: 胰(?:十二指肠|体尾|体|尾|头|腺)[^。；;\n]{0,18}(?:切除术|根治术)|全胰(?:腺)?切除(?:术)?|Whipple(?:手术|术)?
supplement_pattern.intent: 拟施手术名称和手术方式[：:]?|拟施手术名称[：:]?|拟实施|拟施行|拟行|计划|建议|考虑(?:行|施行)|拟

original_candidate_cross_visit_identical.action: Flag only; identical wording is not proof that a new decision did not occur.

additional_aggregate_checks.source_review_kind: Deterministic purposive stratified linguistic/source review by the analyst; no independent clinical adjudication.

zero_candidate_preop_field_review.scope: 13 zero supplemental-candidate patients; pre-op procedure field inspection, not a full negative decision adjudication
